svg.title: Invito Bello — a premium digital-invitation product
svg.desc: Featured project. A premium digital-invitation product designed and developed from scratch: 13 original mobile-first designs, a live personalisation studio, secure publishing after payment, RSVP and guest replies. Role: product, design, frontend, backend and motion. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, GSAP, Three.js, Supabase, Stripe, Razorpay, Resend.

g.text: Couples choose a design, personalise it in a live editor,
publish securely after payment and share one elegant link
Next.js · React · TypeScript · GSAP · Three.js · Supabase · Stripe
